The description does not mention the units for the Y-axis, which are specified in the caption as "в хил.лв." (in thousand BGN).
The orange line for "Селско, горско и рибно стопанство" starts at a value very close to 0, not 15,000.
The line representing "Преработваща промишленост" is grey, not reddish-brown.
The grey line for "Преработваща промишленост" starts at approximately 25,000, not 35,000.
